notes: The Android app is still build-verified only: it has not yet been installed or run on a phone or emulator. New Android-only features (icon disguise, Quick lock tile, shake to freeze, PIN + Keystore) are marked experimental for that reason.
Group invite links and QR codes: admins can set an expiry and a maximum number of uses, and revoke links. Joining is approved automatically the next time an admin's app is online.
Send later and message reminders. Scheduled messages go out at the chosen time only while Vexunori is running; otherwise as soon as you open it.
View-once photos (experimental): deleted after one viewing; screenshots blocked on Android, not possible to block in a browser.
Collaborative notes in group workspaces: edit together with simple formatting (headings, bold, italic, lists and checklists); changes merge automatically.
Hidden profile: a second PIN or passphrase opens a separate profile with its own identity and chats. Someone examining the device's storage can still see that a second encrypted database exists.
PIN option (6+ digits) and PIN + Android Keystore; shake to freeze and a "Quick lock" Quick Settings tile.

App disguise (experimental, Android): choose a Calculator, Notes, Weather, Clock, Calendar or Flashlight icon with a working decoy screen; enter your code to open Vexunori. Not a security feature on its own.
Chat themes (accent colours, backgrounds, bubble style, text size, per-chat colour) and stickers (three built-in packs and your own stickers from photos or GIFs; no GIF search, no tracking).
One-time-pad Morse: WW2-style 5-letter groups enciphered with a random pad shared in person; pads are never reused.
Link another device with full history (experimental): scan a QR, compare 6 words, and your chats, contacts and Vault are copied across encrypted.
Fixes: damaged offline parcels are now always detected (gzip checksum check).
Android builds now run on GitHub Actions; releases are signed locally, so the signing key never leaves the maintainer's computer.
